runtime_scope: Two complete unchanged original Swift modules with native CoreGraphics/AVFoundation. Authored grayscale CGImage fixtures. Explicit fatalError adapter for unused video decoder; video extraction and URL decoding not executed.
findings: Area binning produces empty cells when input dimensions are smaller than requested output; white 1x1 becomes 1023 zero cells and one white cell. Image URL thumbnail creation does not explicitly request upscaling; actual tiny-file URL path remains untested.

Image hash similarity lacks equal-length guard and clamping present in video hash similarity. Authored malformed lengths produce asymmetric negative result. Normal hash(image:) always generates eight bytes; malformed production input not demonstrated.

Image hash removes DC only from median threshold calculation, but includes DC in output bits. Uniform black/white hash similarity was 0.53125 in this control; no visual corpus recall or threshold quality claim.
Video normalization replaces missing sample slots with nearest decoded sample when at least two exist. This policy was read, not executed here.
No upstream source adopted; GPL notices preserved in cached original modules. No performance improvement claimed.
